item.title: Playhead 0.1.0 (build 6)
item.description:
### What's new
- **Playhead for Android TV and Google TV.** Install it once (guide on the Playhead page, under Docs → Android TV); after that it updates itself. - **Remote and keyboard navigation.** The whole app works with a TV remote or the arrow keys, with a clear highlight on the selected item. OK/Enter selects; Back/Escape goes back. - **macOS:** the update window can no longer hide behind Playhead's window. Settings → About shows the exact version you're running.
### Installing on Android TV / Google TV
- No computer: install **Downloader** from the Play Store on the TV, open it and enter `miloshampl.github.io/playhead-releases/apk`. - From a computer: `adb connect` your TV over Wi-Fi and `adb install Playhead-android.apk`. - The first update asks once to allow Playhead to install apps; later updates install by themselves.
